blind.description: A freestanding rectangular cut-stone wall section with stylized, hand-painted chiseled rock facets. One side features an arched recess or shrine niche with dark soot marks above it, while the opposite side is a textured stone surface with angled fracture lines. The base of the wall has painted green moss over the lower stones. The geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly beveled along the top edges with no floating parts or mesh fragmentation.
blind.from_above: A rounded rectangular horizontal slab showing the flat brownish-tan top surface of the wall with softly chiseled edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.3 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7.5 to 8 ft tall) and about 4.5 ft wide.
